description: Failure detection decomposed. Heartbeat patterns, gossip protocols (SWIM), phi accrual, epidemic protocols. The mechanisms by which distributed systems detect (and sometimes wrongly suspect) failed members.

sub_mechanisms.name: periodic_heartbeat
sub_mechanisms.definition: Each node sends 'I'm alive' to monitor at fixed interval. Missing N heartbeats → suspect failure.
sub_mechanisms.why: Simplest. Threshold trade: tight = false positives; loose = slow detection. Foundational baseline.

sub_mechanisms.name: all_to_all_heartbeat
sub_mechanisms.definition: Every node sends heartbeat to every other. O(N²) messages.
sub_mechanisms.why: Strong info but doesn't scale. ~50 nodes max. Replaced by gossip in larger clusters.

sub_mechanisms.name: gossip_dissemination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Each node periodically gossips state to K random peers. Info spreads exponentially.
sub_mechanisms.why: Scalable: O(log N) rounds to converge. Used in Cassandra, Consul, Hashicorp memberlist. Foundation of large-cluster membership.

sub_mechanisms.name: SWIM_direct_probe
sub_mechanisms.definition: Node A probes node B directly with ping. Failure → indirect probes via peers.
sub_mechanisms.why: Distinguishes 'B is dead' from 'A-B network broken'. K indirect probes; if all fail, declare B dead. Hashicorp Memberlist + Serf use.

sub_mechanisms.name: SWIM_indirect_probe
sub_mechanisms.definition: If A can't reach B, A asks K other nodes to ping B. If they succeed, B is alive (network issue between A-B).
sub_mechanisms.why: Reduces false positives from partial partitions. Robust against asymmetric network failures.

sub_mechanisms.name: phi_accrual_value
sub_mechanisms.definition: φ = -log10(P(t_late > t_now - last_heartbeat | normal distribution)). Continuous probability of failure.
sub_mechanisms.why: Not binary up/down. Application decides threshold (φ > 8 = ~99.999999% failed). Adapts to network latency variance. Cassandra, Akka use.

sub_mechanisms.name: ping_pong_RTT_window
sub_mechanisms.definition: Track recent ping RTTs in sliding window. Compute mean + std.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of phi accrual: distribution of normal RTTs. Failure = current latency far in tail of distribution.

sub_mechanisms.name: membership_protocol
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mechanism for nodes to learn cluster composition. Gossip-based membership + version vectors.
sub_mechanisms.why: Knowing who's in cluster prerequisite to detecting failure. Combined with failure detection in SWIM, Consul, etcd.

sub_mechanisms.name: split_brain_avoidance
sub_mechanisms.definition: When network partitions, two sides may each claim leadership. Prevent: majority quorum required.
sub_mechanisms.why: Without: both sides accept writes, conflicting state. With majority: only one side has quorum, other refuses. Raft + Paxos enforce.

sub_mechanisms.name: Byzantine_failure_detection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Detect nodes returning wrong answers (not just silence). Cryptographic signatures + voting.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pure failure detection assumes crash failures. Byzantine: malicious answers. PBFT + HotStuff handle. Required for permissioned blockchain.

sub_mechanisms.name: anti_entropy_state_sync
sub_mechanisms.definition: Periodic full state exchange between replicas. Catch missed updates.
sub_mechanisms.why: Gossip may miss updates; anti-entropy rectifies. Merkle trees enable efficient diff. Cassandra read repair + nodetool repair.

sub_mechanisms.name: fencing_token
sub_mechanisms.definition: Monotonically increasing ID issued by lock service. Operations require fence ≥ current.
sub_mechanisms.why: Prevents zombie processes from corrupting state after fail-over. Process A locked, paused, B took over. A returns, must include fence; storage rejects old fence.

derivation_rules.name: perfect_failure_detection_impossible_async
derivation_rules.why: Slow node indistinguishable from dead. FLP impossibility consequence. Practical detectors are eventually-correct: detect failures eventually, may have false positives.

derivation_rules.name: gossip_scales_to_thousands_of_nodes
derivation_rules.why: All-to-all: O(N²) messages per round = unsustainable. Gossip: each node sends to K peers. O(N×K) total; O(log N) rounds to converge. Cassandra deploys at this scale.

derivation_rules.name: SWIM_handles_asymmetric_partitions
derivation_rules.why: Single probe: A can't reach B; mark B dead. SWIM: K others probe B; if any reach, B is alive. Asymmetric link between A-B detected. Real networks have such failures.

derivation_rules.name: phi_accrual_adapts_to_network_variance
then: phi accrual adapts; fixed thresholds give false positives
derivation_rules.why: Fixed: 'N missed = dead'. Variable latency → N misses common = false positives. Phi: computes probability based on observed distribution. Adapts naturally.

derivation_rules.name: fencing_tokens_required_for_safe_locking
then: fencing token required to prevent zombie writes
derivation_rules.why: Without: paused process resumes, performs write thinking it holds lock. With: storage validates fence; rejects old. Kleppmann's critique of Redlock-style locks. Required for safety.
